senses.gloss: Likhita, an ancient ṛshi, brother of Śaṅkha. § 266 (Śakrasabhāv.): II, 7, 292 (Śaṅkhaś ca Likhitaś ca, in the palace of Indra).--§ 628 (Rājadh.): XII, 23, 668, 670, 671, 678, 679, 686, 690, (693) (the story of L.'s being punished).--§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 56, 3320 (Śaṅkhaś ca Lºas tathā, ascended to heaven by making gifts of sesame seed).--§ 767 (do.): XIII, 137, 6263 (king Sudyumna attained to blessed regions by having caused L. to be punished, cf. § 628). Cf. Brahmarshi.
